description: This file defines the PersistentStore class, which implements a plugin for persistent storage with JSON-RPC interface, including nested classes for configuration and notifications, and declares various endpoints for storage operations.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing persistent storage with JSON-RPC and notifications, managing storage endpoints and events.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for persistent store settings such as paths and size limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore::Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for changes in the IStore2 interface, relaying value changes to the parent PersistentStore.

classes.name: PersistentStore::RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection events, triggering deactivation procedures when connections are lost.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC endpoints and notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC endpoints and notifications.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated method to get storage size.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Event triggered when a stored value changes.
